patch.content:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0)

find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS ${ZEPHYR_BASE})
project(bmp581_test)

# Add the test sources
target_sources(app PRIVATE src/main.c)

# Add the driver's emulation sources if the emulation is enabled.
# This ensures the emulation functions are compiled and linked with the test application.
if(CONFIG_SENSOR_BMP581_EMUL)
  target_sources(app PRIVATE
    ../../../../drivers/sensor/bmp581/emul/bmp581_emul.c
  )
endif()

# Add include directories for the driver and its emulation headers.
# The test's main.c includes "bmp581_emul.h", which is located in the 'emul' directory.
# It might also include "bmp581.h" from the main driver directory.
target_include_directories(app PRIVATE
  ../../../../drivers/sensor/bmp581/
  ../../../../drivers/sensor/bmp581/emul/
)
